description: Explore, the next memory-bound lever on the frozen stem. On the H2.6.2 successor (or the freeze recipe in fcacfc6), at the freeze point: run one no-grad train-mode forward of group 1 over the current batch to set its BN running stats. Use the existing buffers if their values are already the frozen-phase stats. Then, for the frozen phase, put group-1 BN in eval mode and fold scale and shift into the conv weights and biases (done inside timed train, once). The truncated step then runs group 1 as conv+bias+GELU under no_grad, with no BN statistics reductions on the 31×31 maps. Lookahead still averages the unfolded params. Keep the unfolded copies so the final weights and BN buffers stay consistent: either fold only in the compiled frozen forward, or unfold before the final copy. Eval uses the standard model. Capture the new truncated variant in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2.
